title: $:/plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp-core
author: pmario
name: TW MCP Core
description: MCP tool handlers for TiddlyWiki (runtime-agnostic core)
readme:
The runtime-agnostic core of the [[tw-mcp|$:/plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp]] MCP server: the tool handlers (crud, query, render, inspect), the hashline edit engine and the tool dispatcher. It contains no transport and no filesystem tools — the ''tw-mcp'' server plugin adds those plus HTTP/SSE/stdio on top and is the plugin to install for a node MCP server. Install BOTH plugins there; this core alone serves embedders that host the handlers against their own `$tw` (e.g. the Facets bare-vm engine).

Tool handlers are modules of `module-type: mcp-handler`; each export becomes a tool, keyed by export name. Any plugin can contribute tools by shipping such a module.

Code in this plugin must stay runtime-agnostic: no unguarded node requires at load time, and no `\p{...}` regex without feature detection (no-ICU JS engines reject them).

The changelog lives in the [[tw-mcp history|$:/plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp/history]].
